svg.title: Accent diversity is rarely an explicit evaluation target

cc:Work.dc:title: Accent diversity is rarely an explicit evaluation target
cc:Work.dc:description: Each square is a benchmark use in the technical-report audit. 12 of 61 explicitly address multiple accents; 49 do not. Repeated benchmark uses count separately. This is evaluation coverage, not the fraction of training data or the number of distinct benchmark families. Source: Tables I, III and IV of the corrected arXiv paper.
